pages.title: Transfinite Casing
pages.text: A casing built to hold infinities: a transfinite weave over reality lattice casing, with a Russell set and a Banach-Tarski sphere worked into the seams. It looks smaller from the inside than the outside, and larger from the side.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Axiomatic Breach Engine leaked infinities into everything near it. I used a Banach-Tarski sphere, which can be doubled, and a Russell set, which contains itself awkwardly, as a frame that would accept anything.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiomatic Breach Engine, Conceptual Containment Casing, Omnilex Casing.
